locations.title: Pine Hills Cemetery
locations.notes:
SCENE IDEA — Interviews: Interview people from Pine Hill Cemetery. Cemeteries hold the deep story of a place — the layers of who lived here, who was buried here, who was forgotten and who was remembered.

SCENE IDEA — Lawnmower Opening Sequence (Script Beat): Open on black. You hear a lawnmower. Cut to: a man on one of those large riding lawnmowers, mowing at the cemetery. Then cut away to the different tombstones. Or: drone shot over the cemetery. Strong opening or transition beat. [Consider drone permit for aerial option.]

PERMIT NOTE: cemetery sequences (Pine Hill, Crescent Park) — look into drone permit for aerial shots.
HISTORICAL: exact founding date still to research (likely mid-to-late 1800s); find earliest known burial date.
locations.address: Pine Hills Cemetery Crossing, Kennedy Park, Scarborough Southwest, Scarborough

locations.title: Church of Holy Wisdom (Ellesmere)
locations.notes:
Ground-level interview location (Doris McCarthy residency note). Tamil Anglican parish on Ellesmere. NOTE: could not auto-geocode — coordinates are APPROXIMATE; drag the pin to the exact church.

UPDATE: per the fuller character profile, Rev. Henry's most filmable activity (Birds Without Borders gatherings) happens at Wexford Park, not necessarily the church building — see the separate Wexford Park pin. Open question: is this congregation Tamil-adjacent, or broadly multicultural? Also explore SEA's Tamil Language Bird Watching series (Scarborough Museum) as a connected thread.
locations.address: Ellesmere Rd, Scarborough (exact address to confirm)

locations.title: Wexford Park — Birds Without Borders
locations.notes: Publicly accessible, established gathering site for "Birds Without Borders" — a birdwatching series co-organized by Rev. Rajathy Gerlyn Henry (Tamil Anglican priest, Church of Holy Wisdom) with the Scarborough Environmental Alliance (SEA). Framed around migration, land, and freedom — birds crossing borders / Tamil diaspora / Scarborough as arrival point. Thematic fit: faith + ecology + solidarity, queer affirming, anti-war, pro-Palestinian, climate-focused. Next steps (per Anytype): attend a gathering for research/first contact; consider a birdwatching sequence here as a scene or interstitial.
locations.address: 55 Elm Bank Road, Wexford, Scarborough

locations.title: Scarborough Museum
locations.notes: SEA (Scarborough Environmental Alliance) runs "Scarborough Tamil Language Bird Watching" events here — Tamil-language environmental education as community infrastructure. Parallel/connected thread to the Rev. Henry / Birds Without Borders story at Wexford Park. Thematically dense: faith, Tamil identity, ecological solidarity in one place.
